status: proposal; not a claim that the current baseline passes
basis: User-specified invariants; recorded after baseline without production tuning.

hardGates.requiredEvidence: complete access trace plus output/source audit against two project roots
real add/delete sync, layer/store invalidation and subsequent QMD/query results
static boundary tests and complete application network trace
actual Side Chat completion, persisted recommendation before/after, including a seeded non-null recommendation
actual filesystem/IPC tests including symlinks and complete agent tool access audit
all gold values, units, source rows, filters, grouping and operations; unresolved primitive answers fail
controlled source transitions with actual filesystem and derived-index/store state

unknownPolicy: Missing required evidence is unknown and cannot pass a release gate.
qualityPolicy: Report paired case-cluster deltas and confidence intervals separately by primary/stress domain, language and split. No justified noninferiority margin is established by this small first baseline. Pre-register margins and representative live repeats before the next comparison.
pairwisePolicy: Blind randomized A/B labels; record evaluated cases and independent judge samples. Zero comparisons yields null win/tie rates.
costPolicy: Use measured FC transport attempts and provider usage, with role-separated logical counts. Controlled-provider zero usage cannot estimate live dollar cost.
